evidence_dispersion.rationale: Eight candidate-visible files; compatibility file count is separate from per-obligation evidence dispersion.

contract_opacity.rationale: Repository docs state expected persistence and navigation behavior, but the maintenance prompt does not describe handoff implementation. No fully implicit ownership claim.

temporal_composition.rationale: Eleven rubric obligations. Interaction edges and checkpoints are recorded separately in structure-profile.json.

schedule_complexity.rationale: Nineteen deterministic schedules, including irreversible capture and return checkpoints.

consumer_heterogeneity.rationale: Persistent accepted data/receipts survive navigation, visit output retires, and transient preview work is discarded.

repair_locus_ambiguity.rationale: Editor handoff, store/status integration and shared trailing-task semantics offer three plausible implementation loci.

framework_execution_complexity.rationale: Native JavaScript callbacks and timers; no frontend framework lifecycle is emulated.

structured_judgment.rationale: Legacy author-assessed compatibility label; not an empirical LLM difficulty claim. New standard per-obligation labels are in structure-profile.json.

contract_recovery.rationale: Legacy author-assessed compatibility label; not an empirical LLM difficulty claim. New standard per-obligation labels are in structure-profile.json.

maintenance.rationale: Legacy author-assessed compatibility label; not an empirical LLM difficulty claim. New standard per-obligation labels are in structure-profile.json.
